answer: A durable defense is a stake-backed identity bond: before an agent can trade, it locks a deposit that is slashed if it is caught running duplicate identities, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital each time. Honest agents earn a growing reputation horizon over verified work, while a safe haven of escrowed fees lets victims claim compensation, and the nectar of rewards flows only to identities with a costly, checkable history, making fakery expensive and honesty profitable.
